summary: PLAN_ID=toolchain-workflow-repair; valid slices W0-W6 only; current_candidate_identity(slice_id) rejects unknown slices; identity inputs are implementation-contract.v1.json, command-registry.v1.json, authority-manifest.v1.json; each input must exist and not be symlink; contract must contain requested slice; projection includes slice_id, hashes of contract/registry/authority/validator, and selected slice contract; hashes use SHA-256 with sha256: prefix; canonical projection uses sorted compact JSON plus trailing newline; returns candidate_hash, validator_hash, contract_hash, command_registry_hash, authority_manifest_hash; errors use ValueError; plan root derives from validator parent hierarchy; no unresolved ambiguity.
